notes.sowing: Sow {cm:1.3} deep as soon as the soil can be worked, 3 to 6 weeks before your last frost. Seed germinates poorly in soil above {c:27}. For fall, sow 6 to 8 weeks before your first fall frost once the weather has cooled.
notes.care: Long days and warmth make spinach bolt, so sow little and often in spring, about every 10 days, and stop once days regularly pass {c:24}. Plants with 4 or 5 true leaves by late fall can overwinter under mulch or row cover.
notes.harvest: Pick outer leaves at usable size, or cut the whole plant {cm:5} above the soil to regrow. Harvest the whole planting as soon as any plants start to bolt.
